utility.notes: Riverside Public Utilities is the City of Riverside's own municipal electric utility. Riverside is notably absent from SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet, consistent with Riverside having its own municipal utility rather than SCE service.

value.name: Riverside Public Utilities (RPU)
value.notes: RPU is a vertically-integrated municipal utility (like LADWP, Burbank Water and Power, and Glendale Water and Power) — it generates/procures and delivers its own power rather than sitting alongside a separate CCA. No Community Choice Aggregator was found serving Riverside in the sources reviewed this session (Riverside is not a Western Community Energy member, and WCE itself deregistered with the CPUC and dissolved via Chapter 9 bankruptcy in 2021).

interconnection_url.notes: RPU's own solar/NEM interconnection information page — RPU's NEM Interconnection Agreement (separate from the City building permit) is required before a system may be turned on.
